Past lab members

Alumni of the Sensorimotor Lab, now working across academia, clinical practice, and industry.

Liraz Arie, PhD

Postdoctoral Fellow, MGH Institute of Health Professions

Completed her PhD in the lab in 2024, studying dual-task costs in walking for people with bilateral hearing loss. Earned an MSc in Physical Therapy from Tel Aviv University and worked as a senior physical therapist in Israel before joining the lab; also certified in Pilates and yoga instruction. Her long-term research goal is understanding how motor control and cognitive processes interact, to inform fall-risk assessment and rehabilitation in older adults and people with neurological disorders.

Brittani Morris, PT, DPT

Now a Postdoctoral Research Fellow, Columbia University

Completed her PhD in the lab researching vestibular disorders, after practicing as a physical therapist in Ventura, California.

Zhu Wang, PhD

Assistant Professor, Computer Science, University of New Mexico

Researches computer graphics, computer vision, and human–computer interaction. Earned his MS and PhD in Computer Science at NYU Courant, where he built much of the lab's VR testing software.

Kristyn Cheng, DPT

2024 NYU DPT graduate · Research Assistant

Earned a BS and MS in Kinesiology from San Francisco State University before her NYU doctorate, with research spanning sport psychology, human-behavior analysis, and movement science using EMG, force plates, and motion capture.

Jordan Zide, DPT

2024 NYU DPT graduate · Research Assistant

Completed undergraduate studies at Wake Forest University before earning his DPT at NYU, with particular interests in neurological, traumatic brain injury, and amputee physical therapy.

Andrew Medlin, DPT

2023 NYU DPT graduate · Research Assistant

Began at the University of North Texas, where he worked in the Applied Physiology Laboratory studying sport performance and activewear, and represented UNT at the Texas ACSM conference. Also a black belt martial arts instructor.

Sarah Mischianti, DPT

2022 NYU DPT graduate · Research Assistant

Studied developmental genetics and played varsity soccer at Franklin & Marshall College, then worked in biopharma and as a clinical research coordinator at Boston Children's Hospital before her doctorate. Interested in vestibular, neurological, and pediatric physical therapy.

Susie Lunardi, DPT, CSCS

2021 NYU DPT graduate · Research Assistant

Studied cognitive neuroscience at UC San Diego, working in computational and behavioral neuroscience research, before her doctorate. Certified yoga instructor and strength and conditioning specialist.

Madison Pessel, DPT, CSCS

2021 NYU DPT graduate · Research Assistant

Studied biology at James Madison University before her doctorate, with interests in neurologic, vestibular, and pediatric physical therapy.

Marta Gospodarek, PhD

PhD, Music Technology, NYU Steinhardt

Researches spatial audio, sound design, and psychoacoustics for virtual and mixed reality, focusing in the lab on how sound influences postural control. Also worked on audio engineering for NYU Future Reality Lab's VR projects.
